title: Timeless Disney Lines | This Is Disney

author: Disney
description:
Step behind the magic and discover the untold story of how Disneyland came to life—against all odds.
 
Oscar and Emmy-nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks returns with Disneyland Handcrafted, an inspiring documentary that reveals the doubts, challenges, and sheer determination behind Walt Disney’s bold vision. In this exclusive clip, see the making of Disneyland like never before—where every setback made the dream seem impossible, and every triumph proved that it was a miracle Disneyland even opened.
 
Disneyland Handcrafted premieres January 22, 2026 on @Disney YouTube and streams on @disneyplus
